verses.verse:
स्वस्थानाच्च्युतछिद्रस्य वृद्दधया शुद्धि र्विधीयते।
स्वस्थानोद्गत छिद्रस्य लाघवात् परिशोधनम्।।२७।।
verses.text: A hole that has slipped from its proper place is corrected by enlarging it; a hole that has risen from its proper place, by pariśodhana (correction) through making it smaller.

commentary.text: That is, holes that have fallen from their proper place are corrected by making them bigger, and holes that have risen, by making them smaller. Here, the place of śuddha Dhaivata that has been fixed by calculation should in fact, by the test of the ear, be somewhat further down. But if that is done, it may be hard to place a finger on some large bānsurī, and to find that proper place one would have to resort to laborious calculation. So to avoid these two difficulties we have raised Dhaivata a little and made it narrower, and lowered Ṣaḍja a little and made it wider, and accordingly put forward a simple form of the calculation. The further placing of the notes is as follows.
